predicted_sql:
SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    disbursed_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown
WHERE 
    status = 'WRITTEN_OFF';

SELECT 
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM 
    main.payment_event
WHERE 
    payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
    AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM 
    main.person_profile pp
WHERE 
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY 
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT 
    card_id,
    issued_on,
    expires_on
FROM 
    payment_card
WHERE 
    card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY 
    issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    op.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    organization_profile op
JOIN 
    party p ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON op.registered_region = ou.region_code
WHERE 
    ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY 
    op.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    main.organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    main.account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    main.capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM 
    main.delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    main.exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON egm.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM main.loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        WHERE ld_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.institution inst ON eg.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_loan_count,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * !1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id), 
        6
    ) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    main.wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号，
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称，
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 在保余额合计
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    在保余额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    total_contract_amount > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    main.data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan!id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount THEN lbs.principal_balance ELSE 0 END), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM 
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON p.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount THEN lbs.principal_balance ELSE 0 END), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    sec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector sec ON op.industry_code = sec.sector_code
JOIN 
    main.party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND sec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS violation_inflow_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_instruction_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    main.organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op.industry_code AS borrower_industry_code,
    ca.target_industry_code AS agreement_target_industry_code,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    holder_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    holder_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.party holder_from ON ah_from.party_id = holder_from.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party holder_to ON ah_to.party_id = holder_to.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON (
        (pr.source_party_id = holder_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = holder_to.party_id)
        OR 
        (pr.source_party_id = holder_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = holder_from.party_id)
    )
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON so.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT !10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    ROUND(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date), 2) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    main.customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.completion_date IS NULL
    AND cdd.deadline_date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    main.collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) as principal_balance,
    rn as balance_rank
FROM LoanBalances
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    sec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sec.sector_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS industry_rank
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector sec ON op.industry_code = sec.sector_code
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sec.sector_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY sec.sector_name_zh ASC, industry_rank ASC;

SELECT
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM
        payment_event
    GROUP BY
        business_date
) AS daily_stats
ORDER BY
    business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    inst_avg.avg_principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            ROUND(AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        JOIN 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        WHERE 
            lbs_inner.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY 
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS interval_lower_bound,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY interval_lower_bound
ORDER BY interval_lower_bound ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM 
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY 
    collateral_id, 
    valued_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,

WITH account_holders AS (
    SELECT 
        ah.account_id,
        ah.party_id,
        ah.holder_role
    FROM main.account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
),
related_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.source_party_id,
        pr.target_party_id
    FROM main.party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
),
transaction_flow AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        pe.amount,
        COALESCE(a_from.institution_id, a_to.institution_id) AS inst_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM account_holders ah_from 
                JOIN account_holders ah_to ON 1=1
                JOIN related_pairs rp ON rp.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND rp.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
                WHERE ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id 
                  AND ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_related_txn
    FROM main.payment_event pe
    JOIN main.account a_from ON pe.from_account_id = a_from.account_id
    JOIN main.account a_to ON! pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tf.is_related_txn = 1 THEN tf.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(tf.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN tf.is_related_txn = 1 THEN tf.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(tf.amount), 0), 6) AS ratio
FROM transaction_flow tf
JOIN main.institution i ON tf.inst_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

FROM

-- Note: The schema implies gc.guarantor_party_id is the entity providing the guarantee.
-- We need to find cases where the borrower (ca.borrower_party_id) is also the guarantor (gc.guarantor_party_id)
-- BUT the question asks for parties that "obtained loans" AND "provided guarantees externally".
-- The link is: Party A borrows (ca.borrower_party_id = A). Party A guarantees Party B's debt.
-- In this schema, `guarantor_commitment` links a `security_id` to a `guarantor_party_id`.
-- The `security_agreement` is linked to an obligation (`secured_obligation`) which is linked to a `credit_agreement`.
-- If Party A guarantees Party B, there is a security record where `gc.guarantor_party_id` = A.
-- This security record might secure an obligation for Party B (the borrower in that other agreement).
-- The prompt asks for "external guarantees provided by the enterprise".
-- So we need: 
-- 1. Party P has a loan (exists in credit_agreement as borrower_party_id).
-- 2. Party P provides a guarantee (exists in guarantor_commitment as guarantor_party_id).
-- 3. The guarantee is "external", meaning the guaranteed obligation belongs to someone else.
--    However, the schema `secured_obligation` links `security_id` to `agreement_id`. 
--    If Party P guarantees Party Q's loan, there is a `security_agreement` linked to Party Q's `agreement_id` via `secured_obligation`, 
--    and `guarantor_commitment` lists Party P as `guarantor_party_id`.
-- Therefore, we join:
--   credit_agreement (where P is borrower) -> gives us P's loans.
--   guarantor_commitment (where P is guarantor) -> gives us P's guarantees.
--   We must ensure the guarantee is for a DIFFERENT agreement than the loan we are summing for P? 
--   Actually, the question sums "total external guarantee amount" and "total own loan amount".
--   Own loan = SUM(contract_amount) where borrower_party_id = P.
--   External guarantee = SUM(guaranteed_amount) where guarantor_party_id = P AND the secured agreement's borrower != P.
--   Let's refine the join path for guarantees.
--   Path: guarantor_commitment (gc) -> security_agreement (sa) -> secured_obligation (so) -> credit_agreement (ca_target).
--   Here ca_target.borrower_party_id is the party receiving the guarantee.
--   We need gc.guarantor_party_id = P AND ca_target.borrower_party_id != P.

JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc_ext ON p.party_id = gc_ext.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa_ext ON gc_ext.security_id = sa_ext.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so_ext ON sa_ext.security_id = so_ext.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_target ON so_ext.agreement_id = ca_target.agreement_id
WHERE 
    -- Ensure the guarantee is external (guarantor != borrower of the secured loan)
    ca_target.borrower_party_id != p.party_id

    p.party_id, p.display_name

    ROUND(SUM(gc_ext.guaranteed_amount), 2) > ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2)

    p.party_id,

    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id

    p.party_id ASC

    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ps.recognized_amount > 0
    AND ps.required_amount > 0
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM 
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

    payment_card pc ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.payment_type IN ('CASH_WITHDRAWAL', 'CASH_DEPOSIT')
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC, 
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC,
    pe.payment_id ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id AS party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE 
    pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC,
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM 
    main.payment_card
GROUP BY 
    holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 
    card_count DESC,
    holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_card pc
JOIN 
    main.payment_event pe ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id OR pc.settlement_account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN 
    main.card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE 
    pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    ct.name_zh
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_amount DESC, 
    ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS average_amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY 
    channel
HAVING 
    AVG(amount) > 11780000.0
ORDER BY 
    average_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM 
    main.term_deposit td
JOIN 
    main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM 
    main.collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    reference_count DESC,
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ld_inner.agreement_id,
            SUM(ld_inner.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        WHERE 
            ld_inner.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY 
            ld_inner.agreement_id
    ) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.guarantor_party_id ASC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS protection_gap
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    protection_gap > 0
ORDER BY 
    protection_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 1!100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    main.provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_pro!provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.borrower_party_id AS debtor_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4.0
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.recognized_amount - p.required_amount), 2) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    main.provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = p.as_of_date
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.as_of_date = '202!6-06-30'
    AND p.recognized_amount > p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, 
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_over_provision_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC, 
    cg.grade!_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
    c.asset_label AS 抵押物名称,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS 内部评估最高价值,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS 外部评估最高价值,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - 
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 
    2) AS 低估差额
FROM 
    main.collateral_asset c
JOIN 
    main.collateral_valuation cv ON c.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY 
    低估差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cv.valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on) 
        FROM collateral_valuation 
        WHERE collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS "保证人编号",
    p.display_name AS "保证人名称",
    ROUND(COALESCE(w.total_borrowed, 0), 2) AS "自身借款金额合计",
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.total_guaranteed, 0),![]() 2) AS "对外保证金额合计"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) w ON g.guarantor_party_id = w.borrower_party_id
JOIN main.party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE COALESCE(g.total_guaranteed, 0) > COALESCE(w.total_borrowed, 0)
ORDER BY g.total_guaranteed DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号，
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 担保债权金额，
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量，
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    SUM(gc.guar!guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    rtc.name_zh AS exposure_group_type_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_type_catalog egtc ON eg.group_type = egtc.group_type
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON egtc.group_type = rtc.relation_type
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, rtc.name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 
    member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    main.exposure_group_member egm
JOIN 
    main.party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, 
    egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号，
    p.display_name AS 主体名称，
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数，
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party!id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    main.relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    main.exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ca_src.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id THEN ld_src.agreement_id END) AS source_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ca_tgt.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id THEN ld_tgt.agreement_id END) AS target_loan_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_src ON pr.source_party_id = ca_src.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld_src ON ca_src.agreement_id = ld_src.agreement_id AND ld_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = ca_tgt.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld_tgt ON ca_tgt.agreement_id = ld_tgt.agreement_id AND ld_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY 
    (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    c.collateral_type
FROM 
    main.collateral_asset c
LEFT JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl 
    ON c.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id 
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    c.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
   !c.collateral_id;

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM main.guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN main.security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE' 
      AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        ge.guarantor_party_id,
        ge.total_guaranteed_amount,
        COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0) AS own_loan_balance,
        (ge.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0)) AS excess_amount
    FROM guarantor_exposure ge
    LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_balance bl ON ge.guar!guarantor_party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
    WHERE ge.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(bl.total_loan_balance, 0.0)
)
SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS "保证人编号",
    p.display_name AS "保证人名称",
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS "有效保证责任合计",
    ROUND(gc.own_loan_balance, 2) AS "自身贷款金额",
    ROUND(gc.excess_amount, 2) AS "超额担保金额"
FROM guarantor_comparison gc
JOIN main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY gc.excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON gc.guarantor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    gc.commitment_id, p.party_id, p.display_name, gc.guaranteed_amount, gc.status
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    wp.issuer_institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id FROM institution WHERE institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
    )
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth >= 2
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld_inner ON ca.agreement_id = ld_inner.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        WHERE ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
          AND lbs_inner.as_of_date =! '2026-06-30'
          AND lbs_inner.overdue_principal > 0
    )
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式，
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数，
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY 
    被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.collateral_id IS NOT NULL
    AND gc.commitment_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inversion_amount_total,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING 
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 
    inversion_amount_total DESC, 
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    party issuer_party ON ma.issuer_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON issuer_party.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
    AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.holding_id, phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sixty_percent_count
FROM main.collateral_link
WHERE lien_priority = 1 
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_sixty_percent_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM 
    main.institution i
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = SUBSTR(fs.party_id, 5)
WHERE 
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-INST-%'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM 
    main.capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    core_tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    main.institution i
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM 
    main.institution i
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = SUBSTR(fs.party_id, 5)
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM main.financial_snapshot
    WHERE party_id LIKE 'PTY-INST-%'
) total
WHERE 
    fs.party_id LIKE 'PTY-INST-%'
    AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY 
    revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
    AND ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    main.managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    main.term_deposit td
JOIN 
    main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    main.term_deposit td
JOIN 
    main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_assignment sa ON so.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'CONTRACT' 
    AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.role_code = 'TELLER'
GROUP BY 
    sa.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC, 
    sa.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    main.term_deposit td
JOIN 
    main.account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(f.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / f.net_assets) * 1!00, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
    AND p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, f.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC,
    i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY 
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC, 
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS npl_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON ('PTY-' || i.institution_id) = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING 
    (SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets) * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC, 
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(c.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(f.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value) * 100.0 / c.net_capital, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM 
    main.pudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot c ON p.institution_id = c.institution_id AND c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || p.institution_id AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE 
    p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, c.net_capital, f.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to_net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS overdue_submission_count,
    ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_ledger_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_shortfall_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT ca.institution_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
LEFT JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id 
        AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
WHERE 
    rse.exception_flag = 1
    AND rse.completion_date IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_shortfall_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.ratio_value ELSE NULL END), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS distinct_target_parties,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS distinct_relation_types,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    p.party_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT subject_id 
        FROM related_transaction_record_v3 
        WHERE exception_flag = 1
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    distinct_target_parties DESC,
    distinct_relation_types DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS op_risk_valid_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
JOIN 
    account acc ON ou.org_unit_id = acc.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id
WHERE 
    pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 
    op_r!_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
WHERE 
    wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    AND pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ce.record_id) AS custody_valid_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ce.exception_flag = 1 THEN ce.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
FROM 
    main.managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.custody_operation_event_v3 ce ON ma.originator_institution_id = ce.institution_id 
    AND ce.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;
